counterexample: (steps that make 'operator retried' hold come first; they add pump strokes, never remove one)
4 pump strokes with no time between them: exceeds 3 in 30 s
blockingContradictions.detail: INV-SMK-01 allows at most 3 pump stroke(s) in 30 s (under a stuck valve), but SM-SMK-PUMP T-SMK-3 (Stalled x Retry, guard 'operator retried') emits a pump stroke on every repetition, and no guard on it limits repetition or references a clock.
blockingContradictions.ownerAction: decide which governs: bound T-SMK-3 (a clock, a count or a rate in its guard) or amend INV-SMK-01

counterexample: two different commands (e.g. OpenValve and CloseValve) with the same identities and version are the same SmokeEnvelope value
the body is therefore also lost wherever Outbox carries SmokeEnvelope (Pending)
missingInterfaces.detail: The catalog carries all 3 commands (OpenValve, CloseValve, Flush, ...) inside SmokeEnvelope, but `SmokeEnvelope = { CommandId: Guid; Target: ValveId; Version: int64 option }` holds only identities and versions: no field can say which command it is or carry its body. IF-SMK-KERNEL.Decide must distinguish them from that value alone.
missingInterfaces.ownerAction: add the command (a union of the catalog commands, with payloads) to SmokeEnvelope, or name the out-of-band source consumers must read it from
